name: Voxel Feature Composition
definition: Generates per-voxel feature vectors containing coordinates, RGB color, and opacity by sampling points within each Gaussian's volume and weighting them by Gaussian attenuation.
summary: Voxel Feature Composition generates per-voxel feature vectors by sampling 3D Gaussian volumes and weighting by attenuation, unlike Mean Feature Aggregation which averages raw LiDAR points.
